001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import org.clafer.frontend.SourceSpan;
004
005import java.util.ArrayList;
006import java.util.Collections;
007import java.util.List;
008import org.clafer.common.Check;
009
010/**
011 * A Clafer in the model. A Clafer represents both the set and the type. A
012 * concrete is either abstract, concrete, or primitive.
013 *
014 * @author jimmy
015 */
016public abstract class AstClafer implements AstVar {
017
018    private final String name;
019    // The topmost Clafer in the type hierarchy.
020    private final AstAbstractClafer claferClafer;
021    private AstAbstractClafer superClafer;
022    private AstRef ref;
023    private Card groupCard;
024    private SourceSpan span;
025    private final List<AstConcreteClafer> children = new ArrayList<>();
026    private final List<AstAbstractClafer> abstractChildren = new ArrayList<>();
027    private final List<AstConstraint> constraints = new ArrayList<>();
028
029    AstClafer(String name, AstAbstractClafer claferClafer) {
030        this.name = Check.notNull(name);
031        this.claferClafer = claferClafer;
032    }
033
034    /**
035     * Checks if this Clafer is a primitive. The primitives are int, bool, and
036     * string.
037     *
038     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer is a primitive,
039     * {@code false} otherwise
040     */
041    public boolean isPrimitive() {
042        return false;
043    }
044
045    /**
046     * Returns the name of the Clafer.
047     *
048     * @return the name of the Clafer
049     */
050    @Override
051    public String getName() {
052        return name;
053    }
054
055    /**
056     * Check if this Clafer has a supertype. Every Clafer has a supertype except
057     * for the special Clafer at the root of the type hierarchy.
058     *
059     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer has a supertype,
060     * {@code false} otherwise
061     */
062    public boolean hasSuperClafer() {
063        return superClafer != null;
064    }
065
066    /**
067     * Returns the supertype of this Clafer.
068     *
069     * @return the supertype of this Clafer
070     */
071    public AstAbstractClafer getSuperClafer() {
072        return superClafer;
073    }
074
075    /**
076     * Set the supertype of this Clafer.
077     *
078     * @param superClafer the supertype
079     * @return this Clafer
080     */
081    public AstClafer extending(AstAbstractClafer superClafer) {
082        Check.notNull(superClafer);
083        if (hasSuperClafer()) {
084            // Allowed to specialize.
085            if (!AstUtil.getSupers(superClafer).contains(getSuperClafer())) {
086                throw new IllegalArgumentException(this + " already has a super clafer");
087            }
088            getSuperClafer().removeSub(this);
089        }
090        if (hasParent()
091                && !AstUtil.isTop(superClafer)
092                && !AstUtil.isAssignable(getParent(), superClafer.getParent())) {
093            throw new IllegalArgumentException(this + " cannot refine " + superClafer);
094        }
095        superClafer.addSub(this);
096        this.superClafer = superClafer;
097        return this;
098    }
099
100    /**
101     * Check if this Clafer references another Clafer.
102     *
103     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer references another
104     * Clafer, {@code false} otherwise
105     */
106    public boolean hasRef() {
107        return ref != null;
108    }
109
110    /**
111     * Returns this Clafer's reference
112     *
113     * @return this Clafer's reference
114     */
115    public AstRef getRef() {
116        return ref;
117    }
118
119    /**
120     * Set this Clafer's reference to target type.
121     *
122     * @param targetType the type to refer to
123     * @return this Clafer
124     */
125    public AstClafer refTo(AstClafer targetType) {
126        if (hasRef()) {
127            throw new IllegalArgumentException(this + " already has a ref");
128        }
129        AstRef inheritedRef = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(this);
130        if (inheritedRef != null) {
131            if (!AstUtil.isAssignable(targetType, inheritedRef.getTargetType())) {
132                throw new IllegalArgumentException(this + " cannot refine reference from " + inheritedRef.getTargetType() + " to " + targetType);
133            }
134            if (inheritedRef.isUnique()) {
135                throw new IllegalArgumentException(this + " cannot refine reference uniqueness");
136            }
137        }
138        this.ref = new AstRef(this, targetType, false);
139        return this;
140    }
141
142    /**
143     * Set this Clafer's reference to target type along with a uniqueness
144     * constraint.
145     *
146     * @param targetType the type to refer to
147     * @return this Clafer
148     */
149    public AstClafer refToUnique(AstClafer targetType) {
150        if (hasRef()) {
151            throw new IllegalArgumentException(this + " already has a ref");
152        }
153        AstRef inheritedRef = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(this);
154        if (inheritedRef != null && !AstUtil.isAssignable(targetType, inheritedRef.getTargetType())) {
155            throw new IllegalArgumentException(this + " cannot refine reference from " + inheritedRef.getTargetType() + " to " + targetType);
156        }
157        this.ref = new AstRef(this, targetType, true);
158        return this;
159    }
160
161    /**
162     * Check if this Clafer has a group cardinality.
163     *
164     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer has a group cardinality,
165     * {@code false} otherwise
166     */
167    public boolean hasGroupCard() {
168        return groupCard != null;
169    }
170
171    /**
172     * Returns this Clafer's group cardinality.
173     *
174     * @return this Clafer's group cardinality
175     */
176    public Card getGroupCard() {
177        return groupCard;
178    }
179
180    /**
181     * Set this Clafer's group cardinality.
182     *
183     * @param groupCard the group cardinality
184     * @return this Clafer
185     */
186    public AstClafer withGroupCard(Card groupCard) {
187        this.groupCard = Check.notNull(groupCard);
188        return this;
189    }
190
191    /**
192     * Set this Clafer's low group cardinality and set the high group
193     * cardinality to unbounded.
194     *
195     * @param low the low group cardinality
196     * @return this Clafer
197     */
198    public AstClafer withGroupCard(int low) {
199        return withGroupCard(new Card(low));
200    }
201
202    /**
203     * Set this Clafer's group cardinality.
204     *
205     * @param low the low group cardinality
206     * @param high the high group cardinality
207     * @return this Clafer
208     */
209    public AstClafer withGroupCard(int low, int high) {
210        return withGroupCard(new Card(low, high));
211    }
212
213    /**
214     * Check if this Clafer has a position in the source model.
215     *
216     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer has a source span,
217     * {@code false} otherwise
218     */
219    public boolean hasSpan() {
220        return span != null;
221    }
222
223    /**
224     * Returns where this Clafer is declared in the source model.
225     *
226     * @return the source span, or {@code null} if unknown
227     */
228    public SourceSpan getSpan() {
229        return span;
230    }
231
232    /**
233     * Set where this Clafer is declared in the source model.
234     *
235     * @param span the source span
236     * @return this Clafer
237     */
238    public AstClafer at(SourceSpan span) {
239        this.span = Check.notNull(span);
240        return this;
241    }
242
243    public abstract boolean hasParent();
244
245    public abstract AstClafer getParent();
246
247    /**
248     * Checks if this Clafer has any concrete children.
249     *
250     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer has children,
251     * {@code false} otherwise
252     */
253    public boolean hasChildren() {
254        return !children.isEmpty();
255    }
256
257    /**
258     * Returns this Clafer's concrete children
259     *
260     * @return this Clafer's concrete children
261     */
262    public List<AstConcreteClafer> getChildren() {
263        return Collections.unmodifiableList(children);
264    }
265
266    /**
267     * Checks if this Clafer has any abstract children.
268     *
269     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer has abstract children,
270     * {@code false} otherwise
271     */
272    public boolean hasAbstractChildren() {
273        return !abstractChildren.isEmpty();
274    }
275
276    /**
277     * Returns this Clafer's abstract children. A concrete Clafer can have
278     * abstract children too, e.g. {@code abstract Port} nested under the
279     * concrete {@code System}; their subs are nested under {@code System} as
280     * well.
281     *
282     * @return this Clafer's abstract children
283     */
284    public List<AstAbstractClafer> getAbstractChildren() {
285        return Collections.unmodifiableList(abstractChildren);
286    }
287
288    /**
289     * Add a new abstract child under this Clafer.
290     *
291     * @param name the name of the abstract child
292     * @return the new abstract child
293     */
294    public AstAbstractClafer addAbstractChild(String name) {
295        AstAbstractClafer child = new AstAbstractClafer(name, this, getClaferClafer());
296        if (getClaferClafer() != null) {
297            child.extending(getClaferClafer());
298        }
299        abstractChildren.add(child);
300        return child;
301    }
302
303    protected AstAbstractClafer getClaferClafer() {
304        return claferClafer;
305    }
306
307    /**
308     * Add a new concrete child under this Clafer.
309     *
310     * @param name the name of the child
311     * @return the new child
312     */
313    public AstConcreteClafer addChild(String name) {
314        AstConcreteClafer child = new AstConcreteClafer(name, this, getClaferClafer());
315        children.add(child);
316        return child.extending(getClaferClafer());
317    }
318
319    /**
320     * Checks if this Clafer has any constraints.
321     *
322     * @return {@code true} if and only if this Clafer has constraints,
323     * {@code false} otherwise
324     */
325    public boolean hasConstraints() {
326        return !constraints.isEmpty();
327    }
328
329    /**
330     * Returns this Clafer's constraints.
331     *
332     * @return this Clafer's constraints
333     */
334    public List<AstConstraint> getConstraints() {
335        return Collections.unmodifiableList(constraints);
336    }
337
338    /**
339     * Add a new constraint under this Clafer.
340     *
341     * @param expr a tautology
342     * @return the constraint
343     */
344    public AstConstraint addConstraint(AstBoolExpr expr) {
345        return addConstraint(expr, null);
346    }
347
348    /**
349     * Add a new constraint under this Clafer.
350     *
351     * @param expr a tautology
352     * @param span where the constraint is in the source model, or {@code null}
353     * if unknown
354     * @return the constraint
355     */
356    public AstConstraint addConstraint(AstBoolExpr expr, SourceSpan span) {
357        AstConstraint constraint = new AstConstraint(this, expr, false, span);
358        constraints.add(constraint);
359        return constraint;
360    }
361
362    @Override
363    public boolean equals(Object obj) {
364        return this == obj;
365    }
366
367    @Override
368    public int hashCode() {
369        return getName().hashCode();
370    }
371
372    @Override
373    public String toString() {
374        return getName();
375    }
376}
